partnership_announcements.description: Bishwo Shahitto Kendro and bKash are collaborating to expand their nationwide book reading program to Faridpur and Madaripur districts, distributing 40,000 books to educational institutions across Bangladesh.

press_references.value: Customers can get BDT 200 instant cashback receiving remittance via Ria during Eid-ul-Adha

partnership_announcements.description: bKash and Ria Money Transfer launched a joint Eid-ul-Adha cashback campaign enabling remittance receivers in Bangladesh to get instant BDT 200 back on qualifying transfers to bKash accounts during the campaign period.

press_references.value: bKash agent points to enable instalment payments for Metal Motors’ farm machinery

partnership_announcements.description: bKash and Metal Motors signed a new agreement under which Metal Motors will use bKash’s Agent-to-Merchant Cash Collection Solution so farmers can pay instalments for farm machinery at bKash agent points nationwide.

press_references.value: NBR begins large tax payments via MFS

partnership_announcements.description: The National Board of Revenue initiated a collaboration with bKash to enable large tax and VAT payments through bKash's mobile financial services platform.

press_references.value: bKash users can win foreign trips, enjoy up to Tk 4,000 offers on travel payments

partnership_announcements.description: bKash announced a travel payments campaign and jointly introduced prizes with ShareTrip, Amy Travel, and InterContinental Dhaka, offering discounts and rewards from Oct 1, 2025 to Jan 31, 2026 to encourage digital payments in travel services.

press_references.value: BKash, Gulf Exchange partner to revolutionize remittance services for Bangladeshis in Qatar

partnership_announcements.description: bKash and Qatar-based Gulf Exchange announced a strategic partnership enabling Bangladeshi expatriates in Qatar to send remittances directly to bKash wallets in Bangladesh with instant access, competitive rates, and fast transfers; settlement routed via a scheduled commercial bank in Bangladesh.

press_references.value: Customers win prizes after recharging on Banglalink via bKash

partnership_announcements.description: bKash and Banglalink jointly organized a campaign to promote mobile recharge services, offering prizes and cashback to customers who recharged Banglalink numbers via bKash.

product_launches.description: A feature in bKash's Agent app that allows 24/7 e-money transfer and receipt using 'B2B Send (Bank)' and 'B2B Receive (Bank)' services, with limits of Tk2 lakh daily and Tk50 lakh monthly.

overview_description.description: BKash Limited, a subsidiary of BRAC Bank, started as a joint venture between BRAC Bank Limited, Bangladesh and Money in Motion LLC, USA. In April 2013, International Finance Corporation (IFC), a member of the World Bank Group, became an equity partner and in April 2014, Bill & Melinda Gates Foundation became the investor of the company. The ultimate objective of bKash is to ensure access to a broader range of financial services for the people of Bangladesh. It has a special focus to serve the low income masses of the country to achieve broader financial inclusion by providing services that are convenient, affordable and reliable

about_short_description.short_description: BKash is a mobile financial service platform that offers subscription payments, instant refunds, direct charges, and B2C payout services.

product.name: bKash Mobile Financial Services Platform
product.description: A mobile financial services platform for sending, receiving, storing, and using money through a bKash account and app in Bangladesh.

product.name: bKash App
product.description: A mobile application for opening and managing a bKash account and accessing bKash payment, money-transfer, bill-payment, savings, and other financial services.

product.name: Send Money
product.description: A person-to-person money transfer service that lets bKash customers send funds instantly to another bKash account or mobile number.

product.name: Payment
product.description: A digital payment service for paying online and at participating merchants using the bKash app, merchant accounts, or QR codes.

product.name: Cash Out
product.description: A cash-withdrawal service that lets customers withdraw money from bKash agent points and supported partner bank ATMs.

product.name: Add Money
product.description: A funding service for adding money to a bKash account from a linked bank account or supported payment card.
